groups.title: Mission flow, timers and flags
groups.intro: Rule plumbing: run once at start, remember state in flags, measure time, end the mission.

groups.title: Objectives and the star map
groups.intro: Tasks and the objective point are declared in `mission.json` (`tasks`, `points`); these Types change their state. Star map labels are `map_text`.
types: Set Current Objective Point On Ship
Set Current Objective Point Visible On Starmap

groups.title: Triggers, positions and counting events
groups.intro: Conditions that look at where ships are, how often they were hit or fired, and what the player has killed or captured.
types: All Units from Group have entered trigger volume Once
Unit from Group enters trigger volume ( Once per Unit )
Group/Unit contains no mission essential ships
Group/Unit Hit at least x Times
Group/Unit Hit at least x Times by Player ( with eqivalence )
Player has hit Group/Unit at least x Times
Group/Unit Vital Section has >,<,= X damage

groups.title: Groups and ships: spawn, ownership, appearance
groups.intro: Actions that change what a ship is: owner, name, visibility, whether it exists. A group spec is `Group` (a TWT group or an owner) or `Group,Unit` (one named ship).

groups.title: Orders, movement and AI
groups.intro: Scripted orders given to computer ships. The human's own course and throttle are left alone by most of these.
types: Set Max Throttle Percent (Max user settable)
Is Group A attacking Group B
Set Group/Unit Border Zone Return Point

groups.title: Damage and vulnerability
groups.intro: Fractions, not percentages: `0.5` is half. A JSON number is required.

groups.title: Docking, towing and boarding
groups.intro: Docking itself is simulated by `docking.rs`; these Types request it or toggle what is allowed.

groups.title: Camera and NIS cutscenes
groups.intro: A cutscene (NIS) is `NIS Start`, camera Types, then `NIS End`. Use the engine-added `OP Wait` between steps to pace it. Camera motion is smoothed by the engine, so the exact feel is PROVISIONAL.
types: NIS Position Camera Relative to Object
NIS Toggle NIS mode Gun Accuracy

groups.title: Sound, speech, music and HUD
groups.intro: Speech events come from `media.json` `speech` (or the mission's own `opening_speech`).

groups.title: Environment, nebula, animals and asteroids
groups.intro: Scenery and hazards. Nebula and current setups are read from the mission's `environment` data.
types: Mission 9 - If Mortar explodes within Area

groups.title: Fleets, alliances and formations
groups.intro: Player names are the owners listed in `players`; a leading `Player0 Group` always means the human player.
types: Set alliance between PlayerA and PlayerB to TRUE/FALSE

groups.title: Skirmish and teams
groups.intro: Used by skirmish maps. The four end conditions are not read by the rule interpreter but by `victory.rs` (the handler is `victory`) and belong in a map's `victory` list.
types: Team has captured a ship from Group/Unit
Team has destroyed a ship from Group/Unit

groups.title: State-init setup actions
groups.intro: Retail missions place their world with these actions at load time. Most of them are applied while the mission spawns (`campaign.rs`, `environment.rs`) rather than when a rule fires. A hand-written mission normally puts ships, nebulae and currents in `ships` and `environment` instead.

groups.title: Engine-added OP types
groups.intro: Not in the retail game. Every name starts with `OP `. See `docs/modding.md`, "Mission rule extensions", for sequences, rule activation and self-completing tasks.

notes.World Initialize: True on the first evaluation of the world only, then never again. The usual trigger for setup rules.
notes.Flag Condition: Holds when the flag equals `Boolean Value`. A flag that was never set reads FALSE, so `TRUE` needs a prior `Set Flag Action`.
notes.Set Flag Action: Sets the flag to `Boolean Value`. Flags are created on first use.
notes.Timer Condition: Compares the timer's seconds with `Time in seconds`. A timer that was never started is false for every comparison. `Equal To` allows a tiny tolerance and is rarely useful; use `Greater Than`.
notes.Start Timer: Resets the timer to 0 and runs it; starting a running timer restarts it. Timers stand still during the opening-briefing pause.
notes.Stop Timer: Stops the timer advancing; it keeps its last reading (PROVISIONAL: reading after a stop is as the code stores it, not checked against the original).
notes.Goto Next Level: Ends the mission as a victory. `World` is only used to build the end text (the digits give "Mission N complete."); which mission follows is decided elsewhere (PROVISIONAL: see `docs/missions.md`). Only the first end action takes effect.
notes.End Game: Ends the mission as a defeat. `Loser - Custom Message String ID` is looked up in `media.json` `messages`; an unknown id shows "Mission failed". The winner message and the stats flag are accepted but ignored.
notes.Add Victory Points for SinglePlayer: Adds to the mission's score. Must be a whole non-negative JSON number.
notes.Set Objective Task Active State: Shows or hides the task. A name that is not in `tasks` does nothing.
notes.Set Objective Task Failed State: Marks the task failed (or clears it). A name not in `tasks` does nothing.
notes.Set Objective Task Complete State: Marks the task complete (or clears it). A name not in `tasks` does nothing.
notes.Set Current Objective Point: Selects the objective point by `Name` from `points`; `NO OBJECTIVE POINT` clears it. Also drops any point attached to a ship.
notes.Set Current Objective Point On Ship: Attaches the objective marker to the ship(s) of the group instead of a fixed point.
notes.Set Current Objective Point Visible On S: Shows or hides the objective marker on the star map.
notes.Set Map Text Visibility: Shows or hides one `map_text` label on the star map.
notes.Is Starmap Open: Holds while the star map is open.
notes.TUTORIAL - Pause when starmap opens?: Tutorial helper: when TRUE the battle pauses whenever the star map opens.
notes.Is Group In Volume: Level condition: true while any visible, living member is inside the volume. With `Entire Group` TRUE every visible member must be inside. Hidden and dead ships do not count; an empty group is false. (`Entire Group` is read only here, not by `Enter Volume`.)
notes.Enter Volume: Edge condition: true when a member comes in. In a run-once rule it stays true once the group has entered and is still inside (level-triggered, PROVISIONAL); in a repeating rule it is true for one frame per entry. A ship that was already inside at start does not count until it has left once.
notes.Exit Volume: True for one frame when the group goes from having a visible member inside to having none inside.
notes.All Units from Group have entered trigge: True once every living member has been inside the volume at some time (not necessarily together). The extra exported fields are ignored.
notes.Unit from Group enters trigger volume (: Event: each unit counts the first time it is inside; true when at least one new unit has entered since the rule last fired. `Team Name` is read as the team credited, not a filter on the ships (PROVISIONAL). The other exported fields are ignored.
notes.Group to Group Distance: Compares the smallest distance between any visible living member of A and of B, in game units, with `Distance`. False if either group has no such member.
notes.Unit is Within any Nebula: True while any living member is inside any nebula polygon of the mission.
notes.Group Destroyed: True when the group has members and all of them are dead. A misspelled or empty group is never destroyed. A ship that left the group by a transfer is no longer counted.
notes.Group has X members: Compares the number of living members with `number` (the field really is named `number`).
notes.Does Group Contain Unit Name: `Unit Name` is `Group,Unit`. With `Exists?` TRUE, true while that living unit is owned by that group; with FALSE, true when it is not.
notes.Group/Unit contains no mission essential: True when the owner named has no living primary ship. This is the loss rule for the player's fleet.
notes.Group Under Attack: True when any member has been hit since its hit count was last reset (PROVISIONAL). Pair with `Reset Hit Count`.
notes.Group/Unit Hit at least x Times: True when the members' total hit count reaches `Number Of Times Hit` (at least, not more than). Counted until `Reset Hit Count`.
notes.Group/Unit Hit at least x Times by Playe: Hits on the members by one player, compared with `Number Of Times Hit` using `Equivalence`. The retail name has the typo `eqivalence`; keep it.
notes.Player has hit Group/Unit at least x Tim: Hits the player landed on the group, at least `Number Of Times Hit`.
notes.Reset Hit Count: Clears the hit counts the hit conditions read.
notes.Group/Unit Fired X Shots: Compares the members' total shots fired since the last `Reset Shots Fired Count` with `Number Of Rounds Fired`.
notes.Reset Shots Fired Count: Zeroes the shot counter of the group's ships.
notes.Group/Unit has >,<,= X damage: Compares the most damaged member's damage with `Damage Percent`. Damage is a fraction 0..1 (0.5 is half), despite the name. False for an empty group.
notes.Group/Unit Vital Section has >,<,= X dam: Vital sections are not modelled: the whole-ship damage of the worst member stands in (PROVISIONAL). `Vital Section` is ignored.
notes.Unit Flag Texture: With `Boolean` TRUE, true when every member flies the flag texture `Flag Type`; with FALSE, the negation. The group may include ships that left it.
notes.Player Killed A Object: Event per object the player destroyed: `World Object Type` is `Ship` or `Asteroid`. In a repeating rule it fires once per kill.
notes.Player Vs Player capture count: Compares the lifeboats and bases the first player saved or captured from the second with `Number Of Captures`. False when either player is unknown.
notes.Player has no lifeboats: True when no lifeboat is owned by the player, or the player is unknown.
notes.Destroy Group/Unit: Kills the group at once (core to 0).
notes.Transfer Group/Unit to Group: Hands the ships to the target owner.
notes.Set Group/Unit Owner: Same effect as the transfer action, with a player name. `NO PLAYER` is a retail placeholder for unset.
notes.Set Ship Name: `New Ship Name` is an id in `media.json` `ship_names`; an unknown id logs a warning and leaves the name.
notes.Set Ships Flag Texture: Changes the flag texture of the ships.
notes.Set Ship Banner Type: Changes the banner type of the ships.
notes.Set Group/Unit Visibility: Hides or shows the ships. Hidden ships do not trigger volume or distance conditions.
notes.Set Group/Unit Cloak State: Cloaks or uncloaks. `AI Can Override` lets the computer captain uncloak on its own.
notes.Teleport Group/Unit: Moves the group to the first position of the point set; the others are ignored.
notes.Set Group/Unit Mission Essential: Accepted and ignored: essential ships are the primary ships (see `Group/Unit contains no mission essential ships`).
notes.Set Group/Unit Movable: Allows or forbids the ships to move.
notes.Set Lifeboat Creation State: Allows or forbids the ships to release lifeboats when destroyed.
notes.Group to follow path: Makes the group follow `Path Name`. `Follow Mode` is `to end`, `loop`, `teleport loop` or `end to end`; only `loop` loops a ship, the others differ for meteor groups. `Find Closest Point` starts at the nearest point instead of the first.
notes.Set Group Throttle Percent: Throttle as a fraction 0..1. Not applied to the human's ship (a value of 0 stops the player's scripted course only).
notes.Set Max Throttle Percent (Max user setta: Caps the throttle as a fraction 0..1, also for the human.
notes.Set Ship Top Speed Percentage: Treated as the same cap as the max throttle (PROVISIONAL), fraction 0..1.
notes.GroupA to attack GroupB: Adds the target group to the attackers' orders.
notes.GroupA to Ram GroupB: Attack order flown bow-on at emergency speed; contact damage comes from the normal collision rules.
notes.Is Group A attacking Group B: True when a member of A has B in its orders, or fired at B within the last 6 seconds.
notes.Clear all AI commands: Drops the ships' scripted orders. The human's own course and throttle stay.
notes.Set Group/Unit Hold Position: Holds the ships (clears the waypoints) until a `Boolean` FALSE lifts it: the hold persists, in a mission as in a skirmish (a held ship does not steer or follow a path, and still fires; the human's move, dock, tow and board orders also lift it). A missing `Boolean` means TRUE, unlike most boolean fields.
notes.Set Group/Unit AI Captain: Only `Captain_Human` is meaningful: it gives the human control of the ships and makes them the primary. Other captains keep the stance AI.
notes.Set Group/Unit Warning Shot Mode: Makes the ships fire warning shots.
notes.Set Group/Unit Border Zone: Keeps the ships inside a polygon (a `volume`); see the return-point action.
notes.Set Group/Unit Border Zone Return Point: Where a ship that leaves its border zone is sent back to: the first position of the point set.
notes.Damage Group/Unit by X percent: `Percent` is a fraction 0..1 (1 is 100 percent), not 0..100. Each hull section loses that share of its current hit points through the normal hit routine, so it respects vulnerability and a fraction below 1 does not destroy the core by itself.
notes.Set Group/Unit Vulnerability: `Invulnerable Percent` is a fraction 0..1 of incoming damage the ship ignores; 1 is invulnerable.
notes.Dragon - Set AI Stance: Stance for the dragon (space animal) boss, same values as the ship stance.
notes.Dragon - Set Damage Threshold: Damage fraction 0..1 at which the dragon changes behaviour (PROVISIONAL).
notes.Dock Ships: Orders the first group to dock with the second.
notes.Group/Unit Docked: True when any docker is docked at any target.
notes.Set Group/Unit Dockable: Allows or forbids docking at the ships.
notes.Set Group/Unit Boardable: Allows or forbids boarding the ships.
notes.Toggle Island Repair When Docked: Island (base) repairs ships docked to it when TRUE.
notes.Set Dock Time: How long docking takes, in seconds.
notes.Tow Ship: Starts a tow: the first group tows the second.
notes.Break Tow: Ends a tow between the two groups, whichever one is the tower.
notes.Is Ship In Tow: With `Boolean` TRUE, true while a member of the first group tows a member of the second; FALSE negates.
notes.Set Group/Unit Towable: Allows or forbids towing the ships.
notes.NIS Start: Begins a cutscene: letterbox bars on, camera under rule control. The exported visibility and instant-bars fields are ignored.
notes.NIS End: Ends the cutscene, returns the camera and makes all objects visible again.
notes.NIS Set Camera Path: Camera follows `Path Name` (speed default 60 until a speed action). `Jump to start` is ignored.
notes.NIS Set Camera Speed: Sets the speed along the camera path. `Acceleration` is ignored.
notes.NIS Set Transition Camera Speed: Same arm as `NIS Set Camera Speed`.
notes.NIS Focus camera on Group/Unit: The camera looks at the unit; clears a point focus and an attached camera.
notes.NIS Focus camera on Point: The camera looks at the point set.
notes.NIS Attach Camera: Places the camera at `Distance` and the two angles relative to the unit and keeps it there.
notes.NIS Position Camera Relative to Object: A fixed offset from the unit, shown like an attached camera (PROVISIONAL). `Jump to point` is ignored.
notes.NIS Zoom: Field of view (radians, vertical, PROVISIONAL) and how fast it changes per second.
notes.NIS Toggle NIS mode Gun Accuracy: Uses the cutscene gun accuracy while in a NIS.
notes.NIS Toggle All Objects Visibility: Shows or hides every object during a cutscene.
notes.Focus Camera On Group: Orbit camera around a group at a distance and relative angle. `Use Transition` is ignored.
notes.Play speech event: Queues a speech event from `media.json` `speech`. Lines play one after another.
notes.Speech Event Played Once: True after the event has played.
notes.Speech Event Not Played Yet: True while the event has neither played nor been queued nor is playing.
notes.Play Music Track: Plays `File Name` with fades. Volume is a fraction 0..1. `Crossfade transition` is ignored.
notes.Play Special Effect: Plays a sound file by name. `Play As Dialog` is ignored.
notes.Crew Speech - Toggle On Off: Turns the crew's spoken warnings on or off (the field name has `State State`, as exported).
notes.Open Crew and Arms Screens: Opens the crew and arms screens (tutorial).
notes.Open HUD Texture Overlay: Shows a HUD overlay texture by base name.
notes.Open Weapon Bar: Opens or closes the weapon bar (`OpenState`).
notes.Set Radar Active State: Turns the radar on or off.
notes.Setup Space Animal Flock: Gives the flock group a path and a speed. Fields are as for `Group to follow path` plus `Velocity`.
notes.Setup Asteroid Belt: Turns the group into a moving belt along the path, with a random speed in `Velocity Lower/Upper m/sec` and tumble in `Tumble Lower/Upper Rads/sec`.
notes.Set Group Space Objects velocity: Changes the speed of a group of moving space objects (rocks, animals).
notes.Set Nebula Fadeout Distance: Distance over which the nebula fades out.
notes.Set Nebula to Lock Objects: When TRUE ships cannot leave the nebula (`Trap`).
notes.Set Is In Calyan Abyss: Sets a mission-wide "in the Calyan Abyss" state that other engine systems read. PROVISIONAL: what exactly changes is not described here.
notes.Create/Release Event Effect: Creates or releases a named effect at a point set. `Effect Name` is a free text that must match an engine effect.
notes.Mission 9 - Do Dark Matter Explosion: Mission 9 only: the dark-matter blast in the area.
notes.Mission 9 - Teleport Longboat: Mission 9 only: moves the longboat group.
notes.Mission 9 - If Mortar explodes within Ar: Mission 9 only: true after a mortar burst inside the volume, and stays true afterwards.
notes.Set FleetFormation Type: Sets the fleet's formation (None, Custom, LineAbreast, EchelonRight, EchelonLeft, Column, Diamond, Convoy) and whether it is held.
notes.Set Fleet Hold Formation: Only changes whether the formation is held.
notes.Set Fleet Primary Ship: Makes the unit the fleet's primary ship.
notes.Set alliance between PlayerA and PlayerB: TRUE allies the two players, FALSE makes them hostile (both directions).
notes.Team Member Enters Volume: True while a living visible ship of the team is inside the volume (level, not an edge).
notes.Team has captured a ship from Group/Unit: Event quota: true when more than `Number Of Captures` of the group's ships were captured by the team since the rule last fired. So 0 means "at least one".
notes.Team has destroyed a ship from Group/Uni: Event quota like the capture one: more than `Number Of Ships Destroyed`.
notes.Team has X points: True once the team's points reach `Points` (at least).
notes.Grant Team X Points: Adds points to the team (truncated to an integer).
notes.Setup Team Objective: Skirmish: sets the team's objective point and task text for the star map. The winner is decided by the map's end rules, not by this.
notes.Team X Wins: Accepted and does nothing in the interpreter (the end rules of the map decide).
notes.Remaining Team Wins: Accepted and does nothing in the interpreter.
notes.No Human Controlled Ships Remain: Skirmish end condition read by `victory.rs`: no human ship is left.
notes.Skirmish Game Complete: Skirmish end condition read by `victory.rs`: only one side (allies count as one) has ships, or no human ship is left.
notes.*State Init* Setup Ship: Placement-time AI stance and path of the ship with `World Object ID`. The name, owner, primary and boardable fields are applied at spawn, not here.
notes.*State Init* Setup Island: Applied at spawn (owner, combat strength); the action itself does nothing when a rule runs it.
notes.*State Init* Setup Nebula: Applied at spawn by the environment code; running the action does nothing. Read PROVISIONAL for the weather fields' units.
notes.*State Init* Setup Etherium Current: Adds a current along `Etherium Path`. A path the mission does not have only logs a debug message (a retail mission has such a break).
notes.OP Any Of: True if any condition in `Conditions` is true; an empty list is false. Every member is evaluated.
notes.OP Not: Inverts the inner condition's answer of this frame. Not an "is not inside" test for edge conditions: use a level condition.
notes.OP Counter Condition: Compares a counter (0 when never set) with `Value`.
notes.OP Add To Counter: Adds `Value` (may be negative) to a counter.
notes.OP Wait: Pauses the rest of this rule's action list for `Seconds`. Outside a rule's action list it does nothing.
notes.OP Wait Until Speech Done: Pauses until the speech event is neither queued nor playing; an empty name waits for all speech. Put it after the `Play speech event` it waits for.
notes.OP Set Rule Active: Activates or deactivates every rule of that name. A deactivated rule stops a sequence that is waiting.
